Monetary Policy Minutes – 2006

The Reserve Bank publishes minutes of monetary policy meetings two weeks after each meeting. Minutes were first published in December 2007, when minutes for meetings from October 2006 were also released. The following minutes relate to meetings of the Reserve Bank Board, which operated from January 1960 until its final meeting on 18 February 2025.
